outcome: Umbilical cord diameter (UCD) at 17-19 weeks of gestation
cohort: 39 fetuses with trisomy 21 and 39 fetuses without trisomy 21 (control group)
finding: Although the UCD of fetuses with trisomy 21 was slightly thinner than that of normal fetuses at 17-19 weeks of gestation, the difference was not statistically significant, suggesting that UCD measurement alone may not be a reliable screening tool for trisomy 21.
